description: This script automates the process of updating a README file with release information and manifest data for the Raspberry Pi vendor, including fetching and parsing XML manifests, generating comparison tables, and replacing placeholders in a template.

methods.name: fetch_manifest_xml
methods.description: Fetches manifest XML content from a URL constructed with the manifest name and release tag.

methods.name: parse_manifest
methods.description: Parses the manifest XML to extract the Yocto version and a dictionary of layer revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_single
methods.description: Generates a markdown table listing layers and their revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_compare
methods.description: Generates a markdown comparison table between two sets of layer revisions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates fetching, parsing, and updating the README file based on command-line arguments.
